title: ONE MISSILE
BECOMES A FULL WAR
yt_title: What If US and Russia Nuked Each Other? 53 Minutes #shorts
hook: A simulation: the first warheads reach Bangor, Washington at minute sixteen, and by minute fifty-three the exchange is over.

title: SIX WARHEADS
ON WASHINGTON
yt_title: Nukes Hit Washington at Minute 17: Simulated #shorts
hook: A simulation: American submarines fire at Russian bases, six warheads reach Washington at minute seventeen and Kings Bay follows at minute nineteen.

title: 8 WARHEADS EACH
ON FOUR CITIES
